# Behavioural results

Generated by `make behave`. Each cell compares the trace of a converted pipeline on its target engine with the trace of the source pipeline on its own engine.

Totals: 234 pass, 89 diff (explained by the loss report), 24 FAIL (unexplained), 97 blocked.

- `pass`: same ordered markers and same exit status.
- `diff`: the traces differ and the loss report names a feature of the fixture (see the diff list).
- `FAIL`: the traces differ and no loss report entry explains it. The converter is wrong.
- `blocked`: the engine cannot simulate the pair (see the blocked list).
